messages.subject: Time recording - March: 11.5 hours unposted
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Tom,

Our records show 11.5 hours of unposted time for March across your matters. Please post or write off by Friday so we can close the month. If any of it relates to non-chargeable matters, just code it accordingly.

Thanks
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
